maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from hotel booking referrals, advertising, experiences and restaurant bookings, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by online travel agencies, hotels, advertisers and consumers booking tours and restaurants, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through its travel review platform, Viator experiences and TheFork; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Travelers and advertisers can easily use Google, Booking or Expedia instead; switching has little cost or disruption.
